hadith:
Peacemaking - Narrated Abu Huraira:

Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "There is a Sadaqa to be given for every joint of the human body; and for every day on which the sun rises there is a reward of a Sadaqa (i.e. charitable gift) for the one who establishes justice among people."
message:
Here is a spiritual message for reflection:

Since Allah is our sole Lord and Judge, we should establish justice and fairness in all our dealings with others, for every act of justice is an act of charity rewarded by Him. Let us remember that accountability before Al Hakam, the Supreme Judge, awaits us, and this awareness should inspire us to live with integrity and compassion toward those around us.
name:
Al Hakam - الْحَكَمُ - The Judge

The name Al Hakam emphasizes Allah's role as the supreme judge who determines justice and fairness. It signifies His authority to rule over His creation and to decide matters, rewarding the righteous and punishing the wrongdoers. The use of this name serves to remind believers of the ultimate accountability they have in the Hereafter.
verse:
Al-Mu'minun - The Believers - 23:52

Surely this religion of yours is ˹only˺ one, and I am your Lord, so fear Me ˹alone˺.
